acceptance_status: Automated-inventory checkpoint; full functional/native/manual/performance/release parity remains open.
scope: Five tools selectors (snapshots, closed tabs, shortcut action, provider editing and history-clear period) reuse Rust SelectState and Metal control scenes. Native event/focus/AX, popup menus and domain callbacks remain adapters.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. Twenty-one prototype source hashes are matched to committed, live and staged inputs.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

additional_performance_scenario_coverage.purpose: Execute all four opt-in performance scenarios as additional automated coverage, with their default 30 trials. Metal validation is enabled; these are not controlled CPU/GPU/drawable presentation comparisons.

contracts: The five tools selectors use the existing Rust selection/prefix/popup-token state and shared Metal/CPU primitive recipe. Native stores, profile/workspace validation, confirmations, native menu/IME and accessibility adapters remain. The Views branch retains actual native Combobox controls and callbacks.

Timeline options use stable snapshot/closed-item IDs, including distinct IDs for duplicate visible names. Every filter/model refresh resets to index zero and cancels earlier input/menu state, as the native baseline did. Empty lists show one disabled Brak zapisanych pozycji item with the original AX value.

Shortcut changes update the chord and stop recording. Provider choices populate all three editor values. The history period still reaches the real native clear-data confirmation/service path. Existing tests now use backend-neutral control inspection and selection without changing their domain assertions.

Tools rebuilds and profile/workspace transitions cancel selector interaction. Native generation/workspace/profile guards still gate deferred tools commands. Rust window observation handles hide/show and popup cancellation.
Tools contents use preferred sizing. The Rust backend additionally synchronizes native scrolling and refreshes selector GPU viewports; native scroll/layout containers remain adapters.

New runtime coverage checks real Cocoa prefix keys, shortcut recorder cancellation, provider fields, disabled selection, history-period AX, duplicate-name snapshot deletion by identity, filter reset and empty-state recovery. Dedicated Metal coverage checks all five childless controls, clipped screen-space bounds, offscreen hide/reappearance, widget hide/show, resize/theme and page reconstruction.
The Rust controller/recipe already existed; no new crate/library/dependency or license is introduced.
limits: Tools headers, explanatory/status text, actions, form coordination and lists are still native. Other forms, browser-service panels, preference UI descriptions/data and remaining busy/status state, outer layout and native interaction/container ownership remain open.
Native popup/manual IME/candidate-window, VoiceOver, complex bidi/RTL, pointer/trackpad, scale/theme, detach/reattach and GPU recovery acceptance remain open.
Optional scenarios provide execution coverage; no controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation speedup comparison is claimed.
Normal installed applications/profiles were untouched; no release bundle was packaged/signed. Final shipped-binary Apache-2.0/upstream license/notice acceptance remains open.

input.note: 13 common Metal and all 13 Views cases passed; dedicated GPU case assumed that scrolling to the bottom hides the middle snapshot picker in a minimum-height native window. The geometry probe now explicitly uses a 300px tools panel and includes diagnostics, retaining the full offscreen/hidden/reappearance assertions.

initial_probe.resolution: The first dedicated GPU test assumed the middle picker would become fully offscreen at maximum scrolling. A second 300px panel resize probe still observed a 540px viewport and only 60px max scroll, with the picker fully visible. The final native test fixture adds 1200px scroll space after the real controls, keeping all offscreen/hide/reappearance assertions and geometry diagnostics. Production control code was unchanged between these probes.

input.note: Attempted 300px panel did not establish the offscreen precondition; observed visible viewport 540px, content 600px, max scroll 60px and fully visible picker. Final fixture adds native test-only scroll space, preserving all actual controls and offscreen assertions.
